"\n\nSample values available. FPS from the decoder is not FPS from the game or the screen. Observed buffer, WebRTC target, and network minimum are distinct measurements; the playout request does not guarantee the observed value. Decode includes the codec pipeline, not just processing. Do not add these measurements to estimate input-to-photon. WebRTC counters may not include all connection traffic. The index is a local estimate, not a speed test. Pauses are observed by the watchdog, not by capturing each frame."

"In football, tap ATTACK / DEFENSE to switch commands. The exchange is manual. In the kick: drag down for placement, up for cavadinha and to the sides for super kick. Mark combines RT + A.

In the editor, Action allows you to combine buttons; Gestures configure each drag direction. The commands follow the layout of your game.

In CoD, hold and drag Aim or Shoot to move the camera. Aiming when shooting is optional. Dragging the analog stick up towards Run activates running when this option is on.

In shooting games, increase the HUD sensitivity and adjust the dead zone compensation. The maximum turning speed also depends on the controller sensitivity set within the game."
